title: エヴォ・X2：流動の奇跡（リクイッド・ミラクル）

segments.prompt: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Hyper-vibrant, bioluminescent, amorphous liquid graphics, medium close-up frames abstract, colorful plasma forming and dissolving in a cosmic void. The camera slowly orbits the central fluid mass, tracking its gentle movement. The cheerful, bright female voice speaks: <d>[Japanese] エヴォ・エックス・ツー、ローカルAIが創る、無限の彩り。エヴォ・エックス・ツー・ティービー。</d> [Shot 2] overall_soundscape: Gentle, swirling whooshing sounds and soft, echoing pops of energy that follow the fluid movements. non_diegetic_music: A rising, ethereal synth pad with subtle chimes, suggesting endless possibilities.
